data.title: 厄普西隆 · 起居室内衣镜前的曲线微调
data.description: 私密起居室内的高大全身镜前，厄普西隆神情专注地调控着胸口史莱姆战服的聚拢弧度，突然察觉身后房门开启，瞬间双手捂胸、满脸通红地慌乱回眸。
data.location: opulent private dressing room before an ornate gilded full-length mirror
data.action: clutching her slime-padded chest with both hands in startled panic, blushing intensely with teary flustered violet eyes
data.lighting: warm vanity sconce lighting reflecting in the mirror
data.mood: hilarious endearing tsundere vulnerability, secret vanity exposed, intense embarrassment
data.promptProse: In front of a dressing room mirror, blue-haired elf Epsilon covers her chest with hands in deep blushing embarrassment.
data.animaCaption: Epsilon startled while adjusting her slime padding in front of the mirror.
